skills.skill_desc:
"My tailor shop excels at fixing and 'fixing' dolls. Am I right, Muddles?"

(Melissa deals 125% damage to Minions, Creeps, and Summoned Units.)

"Watch me slide forward and boost Attack Speed for 2.5 seconds— Ah, that was just boring…"

"<font color="a6aafb">Muddles</font>, go that way!"
"<font color="a6aafb">Cuddles</font>, come here!"

"The plan goes like this: Throw <font color="a6aafb">Muddles</font> out to pin down the bad guys, and then... I take center stage!"
"I pierce the bad guys while <font color="a6aafb">Giggles</font> hits <font color="a6aafb">Muddles</font> to give them a beating too! Hee, fantastic!"

(<font color="a6aafb">Muddles</font> deals 175<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> on the first hit and links nearby enemies for up to 6s. Linked enemies are slowed by 60%, decaying over 1.5s. They can break the link by moving out of range. <font color="a6aafb">Muddles</font> returns to Melissa early if no enemies are nearby, or immediately if Melissa moves too far away. When <font color="a6aafb">Muddles</font> is present, attack it directly. Attacking it this way cannot trigger multi-hit damage. <font color="a6aafb">Giggles</font> only hits <font color="a6aafb">Muddles</font> when Melissa has a Basic Attack target. Each hit on <font color="a6aafb">Muddles</font> deals 50% of that damage to linked enemies.)

"<font color="a6aafb">Cuddles</font>, protect me! For 4 seconds, let no bad guys come close. Unless I say otherwise!"

(Upon activation, Melissa gains a 300<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> shield and knocks back enemies in the area, dealing 500<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. Enemies attempting to enter the field are knocked back, taking 50<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slowed briefly. Movement skills are interrupted unless the target has Control Immunity.
The field will move with Melissa once, when she's about to move out of the boundary.)
